title: Posted-video source restoration
target: Restore the actual 4b23759+c805318 implementation, not just its profile

provenance: 207709ab87c1dbe3d23c3bad764758784a4d3a6b restores the retained video image's inherited foundation at 6a49e49e7e6a3226197a2ceefcf217cdf55f751e, on vLLM 487ecf187d3dfe74d2cf6119a92881dba403c219. Full lineage and exact input hashes are in provenance/video-source-parity.json and provenance/upstreams.json.
672df9e4155fa1fa12f6dc63dbd41f0fa7272ab7 fixes native generated-header cache handling without changing runtime code.
The native oracle is original test orchestration around the existing vLLM top-k operator ABI and torch.topk; it does not introduce an optimization.

environment.capture_platform: Linux aarch64; head-local HTTP client for full-model captures; macOS source audit

configuration.cache_policy: Unique namespace per repetition; identical prompt bytes and original within-run request configuration
configuration.warmup: 20-request boot shape sweep, long C4 capacity warmup, one discarded exact-workload replay

gates.summary: scripts/check.sh all passes. Clean rebuilt image passes embedded tests, native source gate, and running Python source checks on both ranks.

Focused native subtests pass: 30 FP16/FP32 decode/prefill cases, exact selected values and unique in-range indices across three graph replays, with identical reference/candidate value hashes. This is not the complete production-shape/sanitizer G1 suite.

All tinyGLM token IDs match the retained video image. After two discarded warmup repetitions per arm, the initial three-repetition C1 candidate missed the 5% throughput guard by 0.03 percentage points. A retained ten-repetition follow-up passes C1, C4, and long C2. Both receipts remain included; no speed improvement is claimed.

Partial full-model C4 comparison only: three warmed runs per arm at identical prompt counts, restored then retained original. Median wall 90.678298 vs 87.551781 s; aggregate 22.769525 vs 24.023372 tok/s. Slower point estimates remain unresolved. No alternating full G3 matrix or parity certification.
No broad semantic-quality, tool, multimodal, cancellation, or fault suite was run.
No release/endurance qualification or public promotion is claimed.

limitations: Restores implementation identity; not a new optimization or a claim to reproduce every historical container byte.

tinyGLM used image sha256:c09c9636f7dd7360c4bf6c290969973268f4c963e4e9d6f437fc98473bcd3c9e, built from the restoration working tree before revision labeling. The subsequent clean-source build has separately recorded identity; its stable native binary differs, so its native oracle was rerun. EXL3 and DeepGEMM binaries match the tiny-tested image.
Initial tinyGLM C1 throughput was 5.03% lower than the reference; the retained longer follow-up was 3.17% lower. Do not report only the follow-up or claim a speedup.
The tiny comparison was not interleaved ABAB and unrelated CPU activity remained on the appliance; it is an integration gate, not a publishable performance experiment.
Native top-k may reorder indices or select different members among equal FP16 boundary scores; exact selected-value equality is its tested contract.
No full-model quality or G5 release qualification is established.
The restored full-model C4 median is 6.17% below the retained posted one-off. Source identity is not performance parity; the historical sample is not a contemporary paired baseline.

The contemporary retained-image comparison favors the original: restored median wall is 3.57% longer and video-style aggregate throughput is 5.22% lower. Cause not isolated; do not call performance parity or dismiss the difference as noise.

Both full-model arms produce different text across temperature-zero repetitions and differ from the posted text. Non-repeatability is observed in the original too; neither quality equivalence nor a rebuild-only quality regression is established.

The same automatic GPU memory utilization policy yielded 18.86 GiB KV in the restored startup and 18.24 GiB in the retained-image startup. Background CPU work remained; these are consecutive-arm diagnostic measurements, not an isolated paired G3 campaign.
